_comment: Per-node secret policy. Keyed by Tailscale StableNodeID (get it with `just broker-myid` on the node). 'item' is a Bitwarden item id or name in the broker account's vault; 'get' is which part to read (notes|password|username|uri|totp, default notes). This file names WHICH secrets a node may receive — no secret material — so it is safe to commit. Copy to policy.json and fill in. Parsing is strict (unknown fields other than this top-level _comment are rejected).
